messages:
alex: Heads-up — I just got delayed at the airport. Flight bumped, won't make my 02:00–06:00 UTC primary window. Paging still live. Can someone pick up primary immediately? :airplane:

incident-bot: Pager triggered: high-latency alerts for embeds-service (SEV3). Current agg p50=420ms, p95=1.4s. Runbook: https://git.redwood/runbooks/embeds-latency

maria: I can take primary for the next 3h. @jordan can you be secondary while I slot in? I'll pick up paging and routing. :handshake:

jordan: I can be secondary for the 3h. I'll stay reachable. Do we have any active mitigations or things I should watch?

alex: Active mitigations: rolling restart of embed workers started ~10m ago, autoscaler paused during restart. Customer impact: intermittent timeouts for some feeds/search, error rate ~0.8% on write paths. Dash: http://dash.internal/embeds-latency (heatmap + traces)

maria: ok taking primary. alex — before you hand off, paste the restart runbook steps you executed so I can pick up exactly where you left off. Anyone else we should notify?

alex: paste below: ```
steps:
  - verify queue depth: `kubectl get hpa -n embeds`
  - drain one node: `kubectl scale deployment/embeds-workers --replicas=3`
  - tail logs for errors: `stern embeds-workers -n embeds`
  - watch KV cache warmup: curl -s http://metrics.internal/metrics | grep kv_cache_hits
  - monitor p95 on dash for 10m after each step
```
Also left the maintenance tag: `embeds:manual-restart`. Logs show an OOM spike on pod-7 prior to restart.

maria: got it. I'll take ownership of the pager. I'll set escalation window to 30m and enable the fallback model variant on canary route while we stabilize.

incident-bot: Fallback policy executed: canary -> model-quantized-v2 at 1799997795. Routing changed for 12% of traffic.

jordan: Quick q — does the dedicated pool have capacity to absorb the rerouted traffic? If not I can trigger burst pool spin-up.

maria: confirmed dedicated pool has ~20% spare headroom. I'll flip routing policy to prefer dedicated for customers experiencing >500ms p95.

alex: Thanks. I'm filing a short post-handoff note and leaving contact: +1-555-0101. Follow-up sync at 05:00 UTC on my calendar.

maria: I'll run the healthcheck and smoke tests now: ```curl -s http://embeds.internal/health | jq .``` Will post results in 10m.

jordan: I'll shadow the pager for 30m then go to standby. If p95 > 1s I'll escalate to SRE L2 and open a SEV2 channel.

maria: last thing — rollback instructions for the restart are here: https://git.redwood/runbooks/embeds#rollback. I'll only rollback if error rate >2% or p50 > 800ms for 15m.

alex: confirmed handoff: primary=@maria secondary=@jordan. Leaving notes in the incident thread. Thanks all. :pray:
